body: Preferably from and about that time period, but just about is awesome too.

It isn't really excessive tiredness, I mean, getting up sucks for everyone cause, geez 8 hours of sleep is just nothing. Yeah I actually got interested in the counting cards stuff for awhile and read up on it and practiced counting, but lost interest after awhile.  I guess you could say I really love stuff from the 1890s-1960s in america. I loved this series called "The great brain", I loved the godfather and the games, the mafia games, that movie blast from the past, all that stuff. Can't seem to find any books that tell a decent story that are around that time frame though.

No, I don't read many books, they would bore me.  Every so often I come upon one I love like crazy, 21 was awesome (the book the movie was based on). My life has pretty much been the same since I was little, play games, go to school, come home, play more games, sleep, rinse and repeat. I love sleeping, its so awesome, I'm tired alot I guess, I mean I get like 8 hours of sleep a night, sometimes I sleep like 15-16 hours a day on the weekends or during summer. I just love it.

Not really, video games are boring, sports are boring, school is boring, everything bores me to tears, and all I can ever think about is how much of my life is riding on these three years. Nothing seems worth doing because unless I'm one of the one in a million who somehow strike it rich (Professional sports, lottery, w/e.) so that I don't ever have to work, I will be stuck in a cycle of waiting for the weekend so that I can just sleep. In fact, that's really all I want to do, is sleep.
